|lore=After the Battle of Yavin, it was politically necessary to demonstrate the unstoppable might of the Empire. The ''Executor'' and Death Squadron ensured this objective.
|game_text=Deploy on your Star Destroyer. This ship may draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise (two if Executor). Once per turn, may ▲ one admiral, Tactical Recall, Field Promotion, or one card with 'Executor' in its game text. Counter Assault may not be played. During your move phase, Landing Claw is canceled here.
|errata_history=Versions of [[Flagship (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 3, slip 38 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “Deploy on your Star Destroyer. This ship may draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise (two if Executor). Once per turn, may ▲ one admiral, Tactical Recall, Field Promotion, or one card with 'Executor' in its game text. Counter Assault may not be played. During your move phase, Landing Claw is canceled here.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•38” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS5-38-Flagship-original-slip-2003-06-11.png]]).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Flagship (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 38), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Deploy on your Star Destroyer. It may draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise (two if ''Executor''). Counter Assault is canceled. During your move phase, Landing Claw is canceled here. Once per turn, may take an admiral or a card with “''Executor''” in game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
